beats.label: S1 · The Claffins arrive
beats.text: JP is dead; insurance brothers Matt and Tom Claffin arrive at his funeral and must prove foul play or their family firm collapses.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets up the dual timeline the whole season runs on: past = the sisters' plotting, present = the investigation closing in.

beats.label: S1 · The cabin
beats.text: In flashback, the Garvey sisters despise JP for controlling their sister Grace; Eva and Bibi begin plotting, but their attempt to blow up his cabin fails.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Establishes the core pact — Eva and Bibi as the first conspirators — and the pattern of failed attempts that shapes the season.

beats.label: S1 · Ursula joins
beats.text: JP catches Ursula's affair and tricks a nude photo out of her; she joins the plot and poisons his liver, but Grace feeds it to the dog instead.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Shows JP's blackmail habit that fractures Ursula's marriage — the crack that widens in S2 when she is divorced.

beats.label: S1 · Becka joins
beats.text: JP publicly humiliates Becka after promising to fund her business; she joins as the fourth conspirator, and paintball, drugging and drowning attempts all fail.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Unites all four sisters as active plotters — the shared culpability that binds them for the rest of the series.

beats.label: S1 · The freezer
beats.text: Becka finds JP's dead father George frozen in the family basement and later traps JP's mother Minna in the same freezer; JP dumps George's body in the pond.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The pond dump is the live wire for S2 — George's remains resurface and reopen the whole investigation.

beats.label: S1 · Grace kills JP
beats.text: JP confesses to Grace that he once raped and impregnated Eva; a devastated Grace strangles him, and neighbour Roger helps her stage an ATV accident.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The actual killing — and Roger's complicity — is the secret every S2 beat is built on.

beats.label: S1 · Matt burns the evidence
beats.text: Matt uncovers the truth but burns the evidence when the sisters drop the insurance claim; Grace and Blánaid move in with Eva.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Closes the S1 case and cements the fragile equilibrium — a secret that only a handful of people know — that S2 immediately shatters.

cliffhanger.text: Grace has killed JP and moved in with Eva; her sisters, Roger and Matt all share the secret, and JP's father George lies undiscovered in the pond behind the house.
questions: How long can the sisters live with what Grace did before someone breaks?
What happens when George's body eventually surfaces?
Can Roger carry this secret without falling apart?

characters.name: Grace Garvey
characters.line: JP's widow, who strangled him after he confessed to raping Eva; now living with Eva alongside her daughter Blánaid.

characters.name: Eva Garvey
characters.line: Eldest sister and ringleader of the plot; secretly raped and briefly impregnated by JP a decade ago.

characters.name: Ursula Garvey
characters.line: Middle sister and nurse whose affair with Ben was exposed by JP's blackmail, dragging her into the plot.

characters.name: Bibi Garvey
characters.line: One-eyed sister married to Nora; JP blinded her years ago in a deliberate car crash.

characters.name: Becka Garvey
characters.line: Youngest sister and massage therapist; slept with Matt Claffin without knowing he was investigating the family.

characters.name: Blánaid
characters.line: Grace and JP's teenage daughter, now orphaned of a father and living with Eva.

characters.name: John Paul Williams
characters.line: The sisters' abusive, controlling brother-in-law — now dead by Grace's hand.

characters.name: Roger Muldoon
characters.line: The Garveys' kindly, church-going neighbour who helped Grace stage JP's death as an ATV accident.

characters.name: Matt Claffin
characters.line: Insurance investigator who fell for Becka, worked out how JP really died, and burned the evidence to protect her.

beats.label: S2 · Two years on
beats.text: Two years after JP's death, Grace is about to marry Ian; the discovery of JP's father George in the pond reopens the police investigation.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The trigger that pulls the whole S1 secret back into the open and starts every domino of S2 falling.

beats.label: S2 · Ian vanishes
beats.text: Panicking, Grace tells Ian how JP really died; the next morning Ian has vanished, his phone hidden in Grace's bathroom alongside bloodied clothes.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Puts Grace at the centre of a fresh suspected murder and is the pressure that kills her the next day.

beats.label: S2 · Grace dies
beats.text: As the detectives close in on her contradictions, Grace flees and is killed in a car crash; Ian resurfaces at her funeral to be questioned.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Removes the season's protagonist and reframes everything after around what Grace left behind — Blánaid, the secret, and Ian.

beats.label: S2 · Angelica blackmails
beats.text: Roger's sanctimonious sister Angelica arrives, extracts the JP secret from a grieving Ursula, and starts blackmailing the sisters over what Grace did.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces the season's live antagonist and puts the sisters' freedom in a single outsider's hands.

beats.label: S2 · Overboard
beats.text: Scattering Grace's ashes at sea, the sisters knock Angelica overboard and flee thinking her drowned; she is later found alive but with no memory of the fall.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Adds a second attempted killing to their ledger and puts them back in Detective Houlihan's sights.

beats.label: S2 · Ian is Cormac
beats.text: Eva discovers Ian is really Cormac — a disgraced, abusive ex-cop — and he has cleaned out Blánaid's inheritance and just picked her up from school.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Reframes the whole season: the sisters were fighting the wrong threat, and Blánaid is now in the actual danger.

beats.label: S2 · The cliff
beats.text: Angelica bludgeons Ian and the sisters try to dump the body, but he tumbles off a cliff still alive; Houlihan learns his history and quietly sides with them.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Ends the season with Ian alive, Angelica arrested, and the lead detective on the sisters' side — an entirely new balance of power.

cliffhanger.text: Ian is alive in hospital, warned by the retiring Loftus to disappear and return Blánaid's money; Angelica sits in Houlihan's custody, and Houlihan has chosen to shield the sisters from the police force she still works for.
questions: Will Ian actually leave Blánaid and the sisters alone, or come back for them?
Can Houlihan protect the sisters without her career or her ethics collapsing?
What will Angelica tell the police now she is the one in custody?

characters.name: Eva Garvey
characters.line: Eldest surviving Garvey, now guardian to Blánaid and quietly sleeping with Grace's husband Ian.

characters.name: Ursula Garvey
characters.line: Divorced from Donal; her grief-loose tongue gave Angelica the blackmail material that drives the season.

characters.name: Bibi Garvey
characters.line: Trying for another child with her wife Nora, and increasingly suspicious of Eva's involvement with Ian.

characters.name: Becka Garvey
characters.line: Youngest sister, pregnant by Joe and briefly re-entangled with Matt Claffin during Grace's funeral.

characters.name: Blánaid
characters.line: Grace's teenage daughter, orphaned by her mother's crash and now the person Ian is really after.

characters.name: Grace Garvey
characters.line: JP's widow and the sister who killed him; dies fleeing the police in the second episode.

characters.name: Roger Muldoon
characters.line: The neighbour who helped Grace stage JP's death, still tormented by guilt and blindsided by his own sister's arrival.

characters.name: Angelica Muldoon
characters.line: Roger's pious, meddling sister; blackmailed the Garveys, was left for dead at sea, and is now in police custody after bludgeoning Ian.

characters.name: Ian / Cormac
characters.line: Grace's charming new husband, exposed as a disgraced abusive ex-cop from Tyrone; alive in hospital after his fall from a cliff.
characters.note: known to the sisters as Ian, real name Cormac

characters.name: Detective Houlihan
characters.line: The investigator who has quietly chosen to shield the sisters after realising Ian is the real danger.
